scope: Work-controlled adoption of preserved agent-authored phone-search patch across five client/backend sites, with current-product checks and explicit historical fixture replay.
riskAnalysis: Exact five expression substitutions retain original search and filter behavior, adding a guarded phone-digit branch. No new runtime access, network, customer mutation or agent publication. Current source lock changes deliberately; old task admission closes while historical evidence remains immutable.

threatModel.assets: Search/filter correctness, tenant-scoped paging, source identity, historical receipts and authority.
threatModel.trustBoundaries: Agent inert patch to Work-reviewed product source; current product versus archived offline fixtures.
threatModel.abuseCases: OR branch bypasses filters, digits match missing/unrelated phones, cursor crosses queries, historical fixture bypass enters runtime, browser assertion races debounce.
threatModel.mitigations: Exact artifact/preimage validation; parentheses and predicates retained; phone character and digit-presence gates; actual backend filter/cursor tests; test-only scoped restored overrides; actual request/signature browser waits.

defects.rootCause: Five search paths compared phone formatting literally, so equivalent digit queries missed records.
defects.detectionGap: Previous search tests exercised unmatched and textual queries without equivalent phone formats across client/backend.
defects.regression: Actual backend phone, text, mixed, punctuation, missing phone, country-code and cursor tests; seven original sandbox groups; four-view real browser checks.
defects.historicalPrevention: Shared delivered behavior checked across all five declared paths, not only one client view.

defects.rootCause: Old fixtures and a whole-capability hash assumed the old source remained current after a product fix.
defects.detectionGap: Implementation demonstrations did not test the transition from available task to delivered product.
defects.regression: Current task unavailable, exact adopted hashes, historical assets unchanged, scoped archived replay restores on errors; immutable policy route hashes retained.
defects.historicalPrevention: Current-product and explicitly archived test environments are separate; no runtime guard or frozen baseline is weakened.

rollback: Revert reviewed feature changes if qualification fails; retain original history and denial evidence, never revive consumed approvals.

negativePaths.malformed-response: Unknown codes/raw errors remain hidden; malformed own records counted unverified.
negativePaths.stale-state: Exact task/source/release checks unchanged; history is not execution authority.
negativePaths.concurrency: Existing CAS unchanged; same first consent remains idempotent and exact-bound.
negativePaths.cancellation: Connected fixture stops consent after run and asserts revoked grants/paidfalse.
negativePaths.api-outage: Unconfirmed delivery never retries automatically; exact intent retained for readback.
negativePaths.authorization-denial: Foreign identities filtered before history validation; service actor gets no history.
negativePaths.spending-limit: No accounting policy changes; no paid inference in fixtures.
negativePaths.partial-execution: FinalChief preserves Auditor rejection; successfulworkflow is not proposalacceptance.

proactiveReview.architecture: Existing patch validation, sandbox evidence and Work-controlled publication retained; no new orchestration.
proactiveReview.dependencies: No package, credential or infrastructure changes; current source lock regenerated using canonical normalization.
proactiveReview.threats: Phone branch must not bypass filters or authorization; archived fixtures must not affect current admission.
proactiveReview.failureModes: Original four-stage workflow remains blocked and Auditor unresolved; Work adoption is separately reviewed product delivery.
proactiveReview.faultInjection: Missing phone, unrelated digits, mixed text, country policy, stale cursor, fixture interruption/nesting and asynchronous browser races tested.
proactiveReview.independentChallenge: Independent QA checked actual backend and archive restoration; Auditor inspected exact expressions, source hashes and all authority boundaries.
proactiveReview.recovery: Revert product commit to restore prior behavior; preserve original receipts and review outcomes, never revive consumed grants.
proactiveReview.readiness: 24 current-product checks,76 contracts,39 archived workflow,2 corrected history and9 browser/restoration boundary checks passed; exact hosted qualification required.
